transcript_window.text: Yeah, he was selling huge data links at this point, a big businesses and not just connections to the internet, but he was also hosting their websites, which means he had a bunch of servers and a ton of bandwidth to keep their websites online.

This ISP of his kept growing and things were looking better than ever.
He had over 100 clients at this point.
know, I started working with these advertising agencies that had those big clients and they brought me one and then two and then three and four and five.

yeah, things were going really well until one day I got a weird phone call.
was the phone call that changed everything.
